Jharkhand Civil Service Exam Irregularities Spark Protests and Arrests

Nineteen individuals have been arrested in Jharkhand in connection with alleged irregularities in civil service examinations, according to a government minister. Protests erupted in Ranchi, with students demanding reforms and the resignation of Chief Minister Hemant Soren, whom they deem unfit for office. One student activist continued a hunger strike, stating 'Want Reforms Now'. The Quint reported a viral image featuring Rahul Gandhi, George Soros, and others was AI-generated. Separately, Congress leader P.J. Kurien urged the Lok Sabha Speaker to ensure the Home Minister's presence in the House, citing disappointment over its non-functioning and the government's accountability.
